description: Top-level Nexus profile catalog. A user-facing profile chooses an agent engine; engine-specific configuration remains in that engine's own registry. Existing Engineering Profiles are Dual-engine profiles. Muse is a separate agent plane and must never be coerced into Dual role semantics.

dual.description: Heterogeneous engineering flow using the existing role-based Nexus orchestration.

profiles.description: Muse Agent Plane V0 is installed (engine dispatch, single main agent, tool isolation, controller target authority) and its provider transport is verified. The production profile stays locked until Contributor outbound protection exists (Phase M5): this Contributor-tier checkpoint permits Meta to train on prompts and completions, and contributorProtection.required stays enforced end to end.
